message.content:
Based on my search, here are the ways to log into OneDrive:

## Web Browser (OneDrive Web Version)

1. **Go to the official login URL**: https://onedrive.live.com/login/
2. Click the **"Sign in"** button in the top right corner
3. Enter your **Microsoft account email/phone number** and password
4. Click **"Sign in"** to access your OneDrive

## Desktop App (Windows)

1. Click the **Start menu** and search for "OneDrive"
2. Click on the **OneDrive app** to open it
3. Enter your **Microsoft account credentials** (email and password)
4. Follow the setup prompts to complete sign-in

## Switching or Adding Accounts

If you need to switch between personal and work/school accounts:

1. Click the **OneDrive cloud icon** in your taskbar (near the clock)
   - White icon = Personal OneDrive
   - Blue icon = Work/School OneDrive
2. Click the **gear icon → Settings**
3. Go to the **Account tab**
4. Choose:
   - **"Unlink this PC"** to switch entirely to a different account, OR
   - **"Add an account"** to use multiple accounts simultaneously

## Important Notes

- You need a **Microsoft account** to use OneDrive
- OneDrive supports **one personal account plus one or more work/school accounts** on the same PC
- If you don't have an account, you can create one during the login process

Sources:
1. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/answers/questions/5706456/how-to-login-to-onedrive

3. https://www.systoolsgroup.com/updates/copy-onedrive-files-to-another-onedrive-account/?srsltid=AfmBOopoyZKOygpB-IdleP6mwxfx5h6FPmjBsqtPOqJAEDi5O4mmBvcH
4. https://www.bunian.cn/22394.html
5. https://zhidao.baidu.com/question/931669486309366379.html
6. https://www.cu.edu/doc/how-log-onedrive-pcpdf-3
7. https://inclowdz.wondershare.com/cloud-manage/switch-onedrive-account.html
8. https://www.xda-developers.com/how-to-sign-into-onedrive/
